reasoning: The question asks whether Moonshot will have the top AI model on December 31, 2025 (based on Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard). Evidence shows Moonshot released Kimi K2 Thinking in November 2025 with strong benchmark performance. However, multiple prediction markets indicate Moonshot has minimal probability of having the #1 model by year-end: MLQ.ai shows Moonshot at only 8% (vs Google 58%, OpenAI 34%), and Polymarket's June 30 market shows Moonshot at <1% (vs Anthropic 91.1%). While Moonshot's K2 Thinking performs well on some benchmarks, Anthropic's Claude models dominate current leaderboards and market expectations. The evidence suggests Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI are far more likely to hold the top position. Moonshot's recent progress is notable but insufficient to overcome the strong incumbents.
